name: @joelhooks/pi-herdr
description: Pi package for managing Herdr agents, panes, and runtime sessions from slash commands and LLM tools.

scripts.smoke: bash -lc 'PI_OFFLINE=1 pi -e . --help >/tmp/pi-herdr-help.out 2>/tmp/pi-herdr-help.err; status=$?; rg -n "pi-herdr|herdr_|cannot load|Error loading" /tmp/pi-herdr-help.out /tmp/pi-herdr-help.err || true; exit $status'
